notes.title: Update History
notes.notes:
Update History
1. Scaling errors have been fixed.
2. Equipment drop rate increased by 15% in Adventuring.
3. 20% increased chance of coins and consumables in the Abyss.
4. Significantly increased the number of coin drops in the Abyss.

notes.title: Balance and bug updates
notes.notes:
Update History
1. combat has been rebalanced and corrected.
2. Fixed incorrect rune rewards.
3. Fixed incorrect item tiers.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.014
notes.notes:
1. We have added items that can be purchased with DimensionStone and pstone.
2. DLC purchase history error correction
3. Add DimensionStone ui

notes.title: Update on major changes
notes.notes:
Please make sure to read the description.
1. Network play will be changed to single player mode. Players will fight raid bosses together using the heroes created within their accounts.
2. Hard mode has been added to adventure mode.
3. The existing item composition and item drop areas will be changed.
4. The abilities and skills of heroes will be improved.
5. The AI level of nightmares will be slightly reduced.
6. Skill usage can be cancelled by using basic attacks. Quick action is required.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.002
notes.notes:
■ Correct errors in which the achievement was not completed under certain circumstances
[list]
  [*]Fast growth: Reach Hero Level 10.
  [*]Unlimited Slayer: Clear All Stages with S grade.
  [*]Poverty escape: It holds more than 10,000 gold.
  [*]Until the last one!: Achieve all 49 achievements in the game.
  [*]The ultimate craftsman: Enhance a gear above Level 50 at the Blacksmiths.
  [*]Completed Slayer: Equip items of Level 50 and above on every part.
  [*]Legendary equipment: All random options complete 5 levels of equipment.
[/list]

■ Error correction in excess of 5 level due to duplicate unique option in the tool of S-class equipment
[list]
  [*]Nightmare: Applies [Rupture] debuff LV.1 -> Resistance to Rupture LV.1
  [*]El Guardian: Reduce Skill Cooldown LV.1 -> Resistance to Silence LV.1
  [*]Goldion: Skill Cooldown Time LV.1 -> Resistance to Fire LV.1
  [*]Ruby Metal: Applies [Silence] debuff LV.1 -> Crit Defense LV.1
  [*]Anemine: Applies [Fire] debuff LV.1 -> Resistance to Poison LV.1
  [*]Slaughterer: Attack LV.1 -> Resistance to Silence LV.1
[/list]
■ Added one unique option that was missing from the tool of the SR-level equipment
[list]
  [*]Belltrits: Movement Speed LV.1
  [*]El Sarious: Max Health LV.1
  [*]Gravinus': Active upon taking damage, Reduced Damage Taken LV.1
  [*]Night Xabel: Active upon landing "Basic attack", Heals HP LV.1
[/list]

■ Correct errors that did not indicate equipment specific option information in the sage's stone items of the store
■ Improve network environment
■ For hacking users, We are responding in a disadvantageous manner within the game and will continue to respond.
